result.title: When Can LLM Reasoning Reliably Reuse Intermediate Results?
result.summary: Sampling complete solutions gives large language models more chances to solve a problem, but each attempt starts again. For tasks with several subproblems, all required answers must be correct in the same attempt. Retaining intermediate results can avoid repeating correct work, but errors in those results may affect later attempts. We study when this reuse is reliable and how much computation it requires. For local retries that stop when no candidate passes within the retry budget, we give conditions for correct completion and bound the average number of attempts. We also show how checking cost and the chance of passing a check affect total computation. Experiments across eight reasoning models examine composite mathematics and arithmetic. Across four DeepSeek models, average success on the second subproblem is 36.2 percent without first-subproblem context, 57.2 percent with its answer, and 58.3 percent with its reasoning and answer. These scores measure second-subproblem coverage and include continuations made when selection fails. Arithmetic experiments show that similar first-attempt accuracies can lead to very different coverage after repeated attempts. Code is available at https://github.com/SempraETY/Intermediate-State-Reuse.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在含多个子问题的推理任务中复用中间结果何时可靠、需要多少计算：针对带重试预算的局部重试给出正确完成条件与平均尝试次数界，分析检查成本与通过率对总计算的影响，并在八个推理模型上做复合数学与算术实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于保留子问题答案或推理如何影响后续子问题成功率、以及检查成本与重试预算如何决定总计算的分析，可供核查 LVR 中中间状态复用、验证与停止决策的收益—成本权衡；论文本身非视觉多模态。
